headline: EXPERTS WARN THAT EMPLOYERS MAY END GRATIFICATIONS UNDER NEW LABOUR POLICY
content: Although government claims otherwise, experts warn about potential elimination of worker bonuses under National Competitiveness and Productivity Plan which suggests dividing such benefits across monthly salaries. Professor Jorge Gonzalez Izquierdo emphasizes risk employers might stop granting these perks altogether. He explains how businesses may hire workers at lower wages avoiding bonus payouts upon contract renewal while offering similar packages including pro-rated bonuses elsewhere.
